scope: Actual bundled Three.js scene construction and reduced-motion release/press frame evaluation; no WebGL rendering or UI interaction.
comparison: Every object: geometry attribute/index bytes, material JSON excluding UUID/metadata, exact local/world matrices, visibility/shadow/render flags and userData. Geometry topology counts retained. Only rescuer forearm/upper-arm/sleeve geometry, wrist flattening and removed elbow spheres are allowed.
summaryNote: Aggregate triangle totals were omitted because line geometry had been counted as triangles. Removed elbow mesh triangle deltas remain exact; source comparison and all object preservation verdicts come from the completed original run. The corrected count-only rerun was interrupted to avoid competing with browser validation.
